nom: Clarins Total Eye Lift Refillable Eye Cream

avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review from influencer] I have been using this total eye lift serum for a while now and have noticed a significant difference in my under eye bags and the brightness of my under eyes as well. There really isn't a scent to the serum that I can tell. The quality of the product is great, glides in smooth and doesn't leave the skin feeling greasy which is a plus. Packaging is small but there's actually a lot of product because you only need a small amount of product to pat under the eye. I recommend this product if you struggle with baggy under eyes. It's not going to give you a super total lift but it will lift enough that it's noticeable.
